title: Integral coefficient maps and Stacks adic predicate
statement: For a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, define the discrete condensed valuation ring and its first residue ring by constant sheafification. The scalar map sends each scalar to its constant continuous function. Pull back both maps to a scheme X. Restriction is the termwise derived restriction along the scalar map. On a Noetherian X, stacksConstructible of a discrete integral complex L means local derived completeness for the kernel of the first residue map, after the section-module and small-site equivalences, together with constant-model constructible cohomology and finite relative Tor amplitude for its first derived reduction. The coefficient maps and small-site transports are actual sheaf and module constructions. The separately named residueCondition is the last two conjuncts, without completeness.

def stacksConstructible (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (discreteObj (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) X)))
